upgradeHint: Managed installations verify the release and back up data before updating. Schema changes require a manual upgrade.
confirmHint: The panel will back up its database and restart. The panel will be briefly unavailable; running API sites continue serving traffic.
updateStatusFailed: Update status is unavailable. Reopen this panel to check again.
progressHint: You can close this popup while the update continues. If reconnection takes too long, check the panel service on the host.
updateSucceeded: Updated to v{version}. Health checks passed.
stableOnly: Install prereleases manually using the release instructions.
